verdict.rationale: Fern is a documentation/SDK platform whose AI features consist of hosting/generating MCP servers for others (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) to consume — the evidence consistently shows Fern as the MCP *server* provider, not a product that itself plugs in external MCP servers to gain new tools. There is no evidence of Fern acting as an MCP client consuming third-party servers, and this axis (being extended by MCP servers) is not a fit for a docs/SDK platform's product role.
